// @path: src/lib/ops/totp.ts
// @expect: OPS-PRISMA-IMPORT
// PR1 widened DECLARED_DB_MODULES from two modules to three so that
// src/lib/ops/session.ts could hold operator identity. This fixture is the
// proof that the widening was a widening and not a hole: a FOURTH module
// reaching for the client still fails, on the import, before it has read
// anything.
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { generateSync } from "otplib";

export async function lastStepFor(operatorId) {
  const row = await db.operator.findUnique({ where: { id: operatorId }, select: { lastTotpStep: true } });
  return row?.lastTotpStep ?? null;
}

export function codeForStep(secret, step) {
  return generateSync({ secret, epoch: step * 30 });
}
